lines: The parcel from the last adventure rolled down the library ramp. Mira picked it up.
It has our names on it! Let’s open it and see what is inside.
A Moon Lantern! The card asks us to take it to the balcony before the first evening star.
The friends followed the card towards the balcony. A small door blocked the way. The lantern was too wide to fit through it.
Hello! I’m Pax. We can take the lantern apart, carry every part through, and build the whole lantern again. First, let’s look at the whole lantern.
That is our whole lantern. Every part is here, with no gap and no extra piece. Now we know what we must build again.
The lantern came apart into four pieces. Four glowing carrying spots showed the way through the small door.
I checked one spot twice. That could make us think we carried a part twice. Can you use every spot once?
Four different spots, one time each. All four lantern parts made it through. None was left behind.
Pax showed three plans for taking the round lantern apart.
We need four same-size parts that fill the whole circle. There must be no gap, and no part can sit on top of another.
That plan gives us four clear parts. Together, they fill the same whole circle.
All four lantern parts waited beside the empty round frame.
Put every part into the frame. Use each part once, and leave none behind.
We did it! All four parts fit together. The same whole lantern is back, and the tray is empty.
Pax put two pairs of practice parts on the table.
One pair has parts that are the same size. Look at both pairs before you choose.
Pair A has same-size parts. Pair B has one big part and one small part. Now we can check Pax’s plan.
Mira placed three lantern parts in the round frame. One space was still empty. A lantern part and a triangle were nearby.
Which piece belongs in the empty space? Choose it, and keep the piece that does not belong outside.
The lantern part belongs in the gap. The triangle stays outside because it is not part of this lantern.
Pax held two lantern parts. The other two waited on the tray, so all four were still easy to see.
How many parts am I holding? Then tell me how many parts make the whole lantern.
Pax is holding two. Four parts make the whole lantern. We have all four, so we can rebuild it.
The friends reached the balcony before the first evening star. Tavi asked one last question about their journey.
What did Sol do when we were checking the four carrying spots? Choose what you remember. Then put the lantern on its stand.
Sol checked one spot twice. Then we counted each part once. We took the whole apart, carried every part, and built the whole again!
